<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parsed entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://example.com/external.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top level comment detailing namespace usage -->
  <xi:include href="subcatalog.xml"/>
  <item>
    <?processing-instruction target="data" value="test"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing complex markup: <tag attr="val">&ent;</tag>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % inner "sub-element">
  <!ENTITY % outer "<!ELEMENT %inner; (#PCDATA)>">
  %outer;
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base; Extended">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<root xmlns="http://xml.org/ns/base" xmlns:ns="http://xml.org/ns/other">
  <!-- Deep comment block with special chars <>&'" -->
  <ns:child>
    <?target-pi data="processing..."?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nesting entities inside CDATA: &ref; -> ignored literally but parsed if outside.
    ]]>
    &ref;
  </ns:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA|subsection)*>
  <!ELEMENT subsection (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Second &ent1; Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent3 "Third &ent2; Entity">
]>
<?xml-process-instruction directive="init"?>
<document xmlns="urn:document:ns" xmlns:meta="urn:document:meta">
  <!-- Section comment with multiple lines
       and diverse symbols: !@#$%^&*()_+{}[]|\:;"'<>,.?/ -->
  <section meta:id="s1">
    <?meta-pi action="verify"?>
    <subsection>
      <![CDATA[
        <!DOCTYPE fake-nested-cdata>
        <not-a-tag>content inside cdata</not-a-tag>
      ]]>
      &ent3;
    </subsection>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (name, description)>
  <!ELEMENT name (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock "In Stock">
  <!ENTITY status "&stock; - Ready for dispatch">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet alternate="yes" href="alt.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/store">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <product store:id="P001">
    <?store-pi action="audit" user="admin"?>
    <name>Widget A</name>
    <description>
      <![CDATA[
        Product description with &status; embedded literally.
      ]]>
      Status: &status;
    </description>
  </product>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % remote SYSTEM "http://example.com/ext.dtd">
  %remote;
  <!ENTITY auth "Authorized Personnel Only">
  <!ENTITY msg "Warning: &auth;">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="archive.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:sec="http://archive.org/security">
  <!-- Security boundary comment -->
  <sec:record level="confidential">
    <?sec-pi check="passed"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Confidential payload area. No entity expansion occurs here: &msg;
    ]]>
    &msg;
  </sec:record>
</archive>
